localEquivalentCheck.evidence: open-sse/handlers/imageProviders/index.js IMAGE_ADAPTERS has no `pollinations` or `pol` key, and lookupMediaAdapter (open-sse/handlers/mediaRegistry.js) does no alias resolution; open-sse/providers/registry/pollinations.js declares only the chat transport https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions, no serviceKinds image and no imageConfig; open-sse/executors/pollinations.js is chat-only. g4f-pollinations (g4f.space proxy) is a different provider with chat only.

exports.pollinationsImageAdapter: default image adapter instance (guarded generate adapter)
exports.createPollinationsImageAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, now } for tests
exports.buildPollinationsImageRequest: (model, body) -> Pollinations OpenAI-style body; throws status 400
exports.pollinationsAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState, authScope) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.pollinationsAuth: (credentials) -> { mode: apikey, token } | { mode: anonymous } | { mode: invalid }
exports.pollinationsPublicUrl: public https URL check used for results and the qwen-image reference
exports.POLLINATIONS_ORIGIN: the only origin the key is sent to

auth.keylessBehavior: sent without Authorization; 401/402/403 answer 401 'requires an API key' and never set quotaExhausted

models.notPorted: the source image-model alias `pollinations/kontext` resolves to black-forest-labs/flux-kontext-pro, not to this provider
models.dynamicDiscovery: none for images in the source; static list only. The source's live discovery (providerSets.ts NAMED_OPENAI_STYLE_PROVIDERS) covers the chat /v1/models list and stays on the llm kind.

integrationPoints.change: import { pollinationsImageAdapter } and add `pollinations: pollinationsImageAdapter` and `pol: pollinationsImageAdapter` to IMAGE_ADAPTERS (lookup does no alias resolution); handleImageGenerationCore dispatches it through the guarded `generate` branch after the responseFormats check

serviceKinds ["llm", "image"]; add the eight POLLINATIONS_IMAGE_MODELS rows with kind "image"; imageConfig { baseUrl: POLLINATIONS_IMAGE_URL, supportedSizes: POLLINATIONS_IMAGE_SIZES }; keep noAuth, authModes and the chat transport
list the Pollinations image kind after registration
